name: Xoi chien phong
summary: Sticky rice pounded with garlic, cooled, and turned in a big pan of boiling oil until it puffs into a taut, round ball. It usually comes with roast chicken or gà xối mỡ.
texture: The fried rice puffs taut, like a ball.
howToEat: The cook turns the rice nonstop in the oil and shapes it round as it puffs, which takes strength and speed.
Eat it with roast chicken or gà xối mỡ.
seoTitle: Xoi chien phong in Tien Giang
seoDescription: Xôi chiên phồng, sticky rice fried until it puffs into a ball, eaten with roast chicken or gà xối mỡ.
